title: Vivacious Manipulations
subtitle: Animus — the animating force
text: Blood Rush (PASSIVE, 100): living blood naturally quickens the body. Blood Needle (QUICK, 100): fire a burst of crystallized blood needles at range. Blood Shot (QUICK, 100): launch a single heavy blood projectile. Deadly Gaze (QUICK, 100): lock sight on a target and drain their vitality. Blood Cloud (QUICK, 300): erupt a cloud of blood mist that blinds and burns. Blood Aneurysm (QUICK, 400): rupture a target's vessels internally. Crimson Flame (QUICK, 150): conjure a wave of burning blood-fire. Summon Thrall (QUICK, 500): raise a blood-fed fighter. Summon Avatar (QUICK, 500): manifest a construct of living blood.
